grammar.composition_primitive: Single photographic hero with darkened media field; left-aligned multiline proposition; three short route links grouped beneath; global utility/navigation bar remains above.
grammar.visual_hierarchy: Large bold white headline with tight line width; route labels small and underlined; navigation stays compact and secondary.
grammar.typography_observation: Large bold white headline with tight line width; route labels small and underlined; navigation stays compact and secondary.
grammar.media_observation: Dimmed interior photograph across the hero, with a human subject/context visible; content overlay anchored left.
grammar.spatial_rhythm: Hero followed by a generous white service band; strong contrast between media-led entry and informational body.
grammar.responsive_recomposition: Headline wraps into a narrow column; service-route links become stacked; menu and appointment action stay available at top; image crop narrows while retaining subject/context.
grammar.implementation_boundary: DOM: headline, route links, nav and appointment control. Asset: hero photo. CSS overlay layer separates headline from photo. Keep routes as real links/buttons; avoid raster text.
misuse_constraints: Requires image region with stable low-detail contrast behind copy.
Urgent care routing must not be visually subordinated to the brand statement.
Medical outcome claims require claim-level source review and must not be inferred from the photo.
